verdict.summary: Round 9 finds no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect. The diagnostic remains confined to the failed-parse path, preserves the rejected SPARQL byte-for-byte, and cannot alter execution. Candidate ranking and emitted hints are capped and deterministic; lexical scanning excludes strings, IRIs, comments, variables, numeric literals, and the Unicode, escaped, empty-prefix, and dotted prefixed-name cases that motivated earlier fixes. The public error-contract tests exercise the real transpilation/canary path, prove non-application, cover hint-free failures, and reproduce the prefixed-name regressions. The keyword drift guard and the documentation's explicitly unmeasured, diagnostic-only framing remain consistent with the implementation. Round 8 likewise had no findings, so progress is stagnant under the required scale.
